title: Test cubics on a finite-field Galois orbit

source.citation: Shamil Asgarli, Dragos Ghioca, and Zinovy Reichstein, Linear system of hypersurfaces passing through a Galois orbit, arXiv:2310.10361

translation.notes: The ancillary finite-field calculation is expressed as ten exact base-field determinants. A zero determinant detects a cubic through the conjugate orbit; the last two candidate points give independence.
